REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
PROPERTY PRESERVATION COMMISSION
TUESDAY - JULY 30, 2019 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Staff reports are available for public inspection at the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center, 18135 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA
90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1203. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to
the Property Preservation Commission after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the Cerritos Sheriff''s Station/Community Safety Center at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: Public comments will be allowed on all Agenda items at the
time each matter comes up for discussion. The public comments portion of the
meeting will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five
minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of
appropriate responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence
for the record.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Pledge of Allegiance
3.
Roll Call
4.
Approval of Minutes for June 25, 2019
5.
Public Comments
6.
Public Hearing Items
A.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 19203 Benfield Avenue, Cerritos, California, 90703, has overgrown vegetation, dead vegetation, a lack of landscape maintenance, and debris and trash cans stored in public view which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7049-010-013).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-64
B.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 13500 Ashworth Place, Cerritos, California, 90703, has a lack of adequate ground cover which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7023-003-024).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-65
C.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 12369 Caravel Place, Cerritos, California, 90703, has structure exteriors in need of repair and paint which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7024-008-040).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-66
D.
A request submitted by the City of Cerritos, Community Safety Division, to the Property Preservation Commission for confirmation that the property located at 18911 Watson Avenue, Cerritos, California, 90703, has trash cans stored in public view, weeds, a lack of landscape maintenance, and a lack of adequate ground cover which violates Section 6.20.040 of the Cerritos Municipal Code (APN 7028-011-053).
Property Preservation Commission Case No. PPC 2019-67
7.
Communications from Community Safety Division Staff
8.
Communications from the Property Preservation Commission and Report on Meetings
9.
Adjournment
